report.summary:
Patient P-D012 (age 47, Medicaid via Lakeshore Community Health Plan, transport benefit: yes) screened positive for transportation barriers and lives in sheltered homelessness (Z59.01). Active problems: T2DM with diabetic polyneuropathy (E11.42). Medications: insulin glargine pen ($2/mo copay) and gabapentin ($1/mo copay), no refill gaps. Needs requested: med_cost and transport.

Med_cost: copays are already minimal, but options exist for further help. Transport: patient is eligible for Medicaid non-emergency medical transportation (Ride Line) as a Medicaid plan member; must call at least 2 business days ahead using the number on the insurance card. Senior Shuttle (60+) and paratransit (ADA certification, up to 21 days) are not primary fits given age 47, though paratransit could be explored if disability-related mobility limitations apply.

options.name: Clinic Rx Fund (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Short-term copay help for current patients of this clinic; ask the clinic social work/front desk to apply.

options.name: Prescription savings card signup
options.how_to_access: Complete the signup form to check qualification; response within one business day. Requires full name, DOB, medications, and insurance details.

options.name: Community Pharmacy Assistance (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Help applying for Extra Help and manufacturer patient-assistance programs; contact the clinic for a referral.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Eligible as a Lakeshore Community Health Plan (Medicaid) member. Call the member-services number on the insurance card at least 2 business days before each appointment to schedule a ride.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone if disability-related mobility limitations apply; decisions take up to 21 days.
